name: Ground: late night
when: Behind a full-screen graphic, when the scene has no shot of its own to blur and the video wants a darker ground than ground-B's deep coral, still in Vice City colours (owner, 17 Nov 2026: "keep the coloured ground, but add a darker alternative"). Late night: the darkest, for a moody or night-time video. White text and photo cards stand out on it. A game switch (gameswitch-A) over the same video takes the matching plate: plate "late".
anchor: None of its own: it starts and ends with the full-screen graphic on top.

vars.out: seconds: the ground's length, the same as the full-screen graphic on top (make_scene sets the scene's length from it)

placement: Mount it under a full-screen graphic (layer fullscreen) with the same --start, and set out to the graphic's length. Its host goes below the graphic's host in z-index.
source: algrow-gta-pipeline/lab/deepground (candidate D3, validated by the owner on 17 Nov 2026: out/deepground-D3_clean.mp4)
changed: ground-B's template with the D3 colours the lab set over its tokens (lab/deepground/build.mjs). The grain is ground-B's, unchanged.
